query_text: Create a slope chart for the 10 countries with the largest absolute gap between diagnostics share and support-adaptation share in the 2021 report, where each slope connects `diagnostics / total sampled innovations` and `(grants_support_initiatives + life_business_adaptation) / total sampled innovations`, values are percentages, only countries with at least 10 total sampled innovations are eligible, and countries are sorted by the absolute percentage-point gap after both shares are derived.
